yt_title: The Lily Pad Puzzle Most People Get Wrong #Shorts
desc: Lily pads double every day and cover a lake in 48 days. On which day is it half covered? Day 47, not 24. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Did you say 24? 🪷 Be honest. Comment your first answer.

lines.text: Lily pads on a lake double in size every single day.
It takes forty eight days to cover the whole lake.
On which day was the lake half covered?
Most people say day twenty four, but that's wrong.
If it doubles daily, then half covered means one day before full. Day forty seven.
